vicinity.en: Several research stations were established in the vicinity of the volcano.
vicinity.zh: 在火山附近设立了若干研究站。

vicinity.en: Homes in the vicinity of the highway experience higher noise levels.
vicinity.zh: 高速公路附近的住宅承受着更高的噪声水平。

vicinity.en: No similar fossil remains have been found in the wider vicinity.
vicinity.zh: 在更广泛的周边地区尚未发现类似的化石遗存。

delicacy.en: The negotiation was conducted with considerable delicacy and restraint.
delicacy.zh: 这场谈判以极大的谨慎和克制进行。

delicacy.en: The delicacy of the situation made any public comment inappropriate.
delicacy.zh: 局势的微妙之处使得任何公开评论都不合适。

delicacy.en: Visitors admired the delicacy of the lacework on the ancient vase.
delicacy.zh: 参观者赞叹这只古花瓶上蕾丝工艺的精巧。

derivation.en: The derivation of the formula took the graduate student several months.
derivation.zh: 这个公式的推导花了那名研究生好几个月时间。

derivation.en: The historical derivation of the term reveals its origins in classical philosophy.
derivation.zh: 这一术语的历史渊源揭示了它源自古典哲学。

derivation.en: This annotation is a modern derivation of an earlier medieval manuscript.
derivation.zh: 这份注释是早年中世纪手稿的现代派生物。

fathom.en: Scientists are still unable to fathom why the migration pattern has shifted.
fathom.zh: 科学家仍无法弄清迁徙模式为何发生了转变。

fathom.en: It is difficult to fathom how the manuscript survived the fire.
fathom.zh: 很难想象这份手稿是如何在火灾中幸存下来的。

fathom.en: She could hardly fathom the scale of the reconstruction project.
fathom.zh: 她几乎无法理解这项重建工程的规模。

misgiving.en: Several committee members voiced misgivings about the pace of the reform.
misgiving.zh: 几位委员会成员对改革的推进速度表达了疑虑。

misgiving.en: She had serious misgivings about the reliability of the secondary data.
misgiving.zh: 她对二手数据的可靠性抱有严重的顾虑。

misgiving.en: Initial misgivings faded once the new procedure had been tested successfully.
misgiving.zh: 新程序成功通过测试后，最初的疑虑便烟消云散。

systematize.en: The committee sought to systematize the collection of oral histories from rural families.
systematize.zh: 该委员会试图把农村家庭的口述史收集工作系统化。

systematize.en: Teachers systematize feedback so that students receive consistent guidance across subjects.
systematize.zh: 教师将反馈系统化，使学生能在各科目中获得一致的指导。

systematize.en: Her effort to systematize scattered data reshaped the entire field of inquiry.
systematize.zh: 她将零散数据系统化的努力重塑了整个研究领域。

thrive.en: Independent bookshops have thrived in cities that support local cultural spending.
thrive.zh: 在支持本地文化消费的城市里，独立书店蓬勃发展。

thrive.en: These plants thrive in humid conditions where most species cannot survive.
thrive.zh: 这些植物在多数物种无法存活的高湿环境中茁壮成长。

thrive.en: Startups thrive when universities and industry maintain long-term partnerships.
thrive.zh: 当大学与产业保持长期合作时，初创企业便能蓬勃发展。

ignite.en: The dispute ignited a heated debate across the entire discipline.
ignite.zh: 这场争端在整个学科内引发了激烈争论。

ignite.en: Her presentation ignited new interest in the study of ancient trade routes.
ignite.zh: 她的演讲重新点燃了人们对古代贸易路线研究的兴趣。

ignite.en: Dry vegetation can ignite and spread fire very quickly in summer winds.
ignite.zh: 干燥的植被在夏季风势下极易被点燃并迅速蔓延。

inspiration.en: The lecture provided genuine inspiration for her doctoral research.
inspiration.zh: 这场讲座为她的博士研究带来了真正的启发。

inspiration.en: Rural landscapes were a constant inspiration to the young painter.
inspiration.zh: 乡村景色一直是这位年轻画家的灵感来源。

inspiration.en: The team's success offered inspiration to laboratories across the region.
inspiration.zh: 该团队的成功为整个地区的实验室带来了启发。

layman.en: A layman should be able to understand the abstract without consulting a technical glossary.
layman.zh: 外行不查专业术语表也应该能看懂这份摘要。

layman.en: Even to a layman, the corruption of public records appears obvious.
layman.zh: 即使对外行而言，公共记录的腐败也显得十分明显。

layman.en: The lecture explained specialized economics for a layman audience of local reporters.
layman.zh: 这场讲座为当地记者组成的门外汉听众讲解了专业经济学。

infancy.en: The field of computer science was still in its infancy forty years ago.
infancy.zh: 四十年前，计算机科学这一领域仍处于早期阶段。

infancy.en: Her interest in linguistics began in the infancy of her academic career.
infancy.zh: 她对语言学的兴趣始于其学术生涯的初期。

infancy.en: Most of the laboratory's funding shrank during the project's infancy.
infancy.zh: 该实验室的大部分资金在项目初期有所缩水。
